title: Dust in the Lamplight
intent: A quiet solo-piano study miniature portraying concentration settling into stillness through delicate repetition and gradual thinning.

tempo.feel: Slow rocking 6/8 with an understated left-hand ostinato and spacious, unhurried phrasing.

tonality.mode: natural minor with brief B Phrygian color and added-tone ambiguity

instrumentation.name: acoustic piano
instrumentation.role: Carries a transparent two-bar arpeggiated ostinato, then introduces a restrained singing melody and subtle inner-voice variations.
instrumentation.timbre: Warm, clear, intimate felt-like tone; lightly articulated arpeggios, gentle legato melody, restrained pedal resonance.

structure.direction: Sparse two-bar arpeggiated figure in the middle register, with quiet left-hand rocking pulse and generous space.
Introduce a simple singing melody above the repeating figure. Vary the final notes of the pattern and add slowly shifting tones without increasing volume.
Briefly deepen the bass register and introduce subtle B Phrygian color while maintaining the same calm dynamic and restrained pulse.
Thin the texture, leaving a partial return of the opening figure with fewer notes and more silence.
Let the final upper tones and pedal resonance decay naturally, without a forceful cadence.

production: Intimate acoustic piano recording in a quiet, modest room with restrained natural reverberation, clear separation of bass, middle, and treble registers, and controlled dynamics. Clean studio recording, natural acoustic timbres, smooth transients and controlled peaks.
